key_failure_mechanism: Single-reference static raster/vector form plus generic words such as heavy/light/asymmetric cannot identify real artist stroke-construction process; surface warp and simple glyph spacing remain a font decoration process. Need source-backed calligraphic stroke segmentation and renderer conditioning before new image trial.

avoid_repeat: do not ask general image generator for research infographic
do not manually retouch one character until it looks good
do not claim cross-character blind pass from Figma technical board
next_experiment.next_action: Use licensed coherent multiglyph/multiexample reference family plus independent per-stroke masks or author process evidence to derive a true stroke-level visual program; then run a single controlled new-word output against frozen baseline via a prompt-controllable image renderer, in a separate supported account or tool; record actual pixels and blind review.
next_experiment.underdetermination_warning: From static final artwork alone, original motion, brush pressure, tool, speed, and author decision process cannot be uniquely inferred.
